test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the option that has an error in the sentence.

A bigger budget has been set aside for this years marketing campaign in Asia.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the phrase "**for this years**."
 
• The term "years" should have an apostrophe to indicate possession. The correct form is "**this year's**."
 
• Apostrophes are used to show that something belongs to someone or something, and in this context, the marketing campaign belongs to this year.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A bigger budget has been set aside for this year's marketing campaign in Asia."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "A bigger budget" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **B: "has been set aside"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "marketing campaign in Asia"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
